result.topic_en: Gauss expresses the columns of a double series T (related to the elliptic/Kepler problem) in closed form, introduces the parameter λ=(a−b)/(a+b) in place of k, expands T in powers of t and λ, and gives series relating t and u = cos E + i sin E (E the eccentric anomaly) and their logarithms; dated law found 1839 Oct. 9.
result.transcription:
177
Die erste senkrechte Reihe in T ist $= \frac{1-(1-4ktt)^{\frac12}}{2kt}$
die zweite $= \frac{1-(1-2ktt+2kktt^4)(1-4ktt)^{-\frac12}}{2t^3}$
die dritte $= \frac{k}{t^5}\{1-ktt-(1-7ktt+12kkt^4-2k^3t^6-k^4t^8)\,(1-4ktt)^{-\frac32}\}$
Es wird hier der constante Theil von $TT'$
$= 1+kk * -k^6-k^8+k^{10}\ldots$
$= 1:(1-kk+k^4 * * -k^{10}\ldots$
Es wird gut sein, anstatt $k$ einzuführen $\lambda = \frac{a-b}{a+b} =$
$k = \frac{\lambda}{1+\lambda\lambda}$
$\lambda = k+k^3+2k^5+5k^7+14k^9+42k^{11} = \frac{1-\sqrt{(1-4kk)}}{2k}$
$T = t$
$+t^3(\lambda-3\lambda^3+10\lambda^5-29\lambda^7+73\lambda^9-$
$+t^5(2\lambda\lambda-13\lambda^4+66\lambda^6-277\lambda^8+1007\lambda^{10}+$
$+t^7(5\lambda^3-51\lambda^5+352\lambda^7-1932\lambda^9+$
$+t^9(14\lambda^4-196\lambda^6+1720\lambda^8-11665\lambda^{10}-$
$+t^{11}(42\lambda^5-750\lambda^7+8010\lambda^9-$
$+t^{13}(132\lambda^6-2871\lambda^8+36190[?]\lambda^{10}-$
$+t^{15}(429\lambda^7-11011\lambda^9+$
$=(1+2\lambda\lambda+\lambda^4+2\lambda^6+2\lambda^8 * \ldots)(u+\lambda u^{-1})$
wenn $u=\cos E+i\sin E$; $E$ excentr. Anomalie
Hieraus
$t = u+\lambda(u^{-1}-u^3)+\lambda\lambda(-u+u^5)+\lambda^3(-u^{-1}+2u^3-u^7)+\lambda^4(-u^{-3}+2u-2u^5+u^9)\ldots$
wie auch
$\log t = \log u+\lambda(u^{-2}-u^2)+\lambda\lambda(-\frac12u^{-4}+\frac12u^4)+\lambda^3(\frac13u^{-6}-u^{-2}+u^2-\frac13u^6)+\lambda^4(-\frac14u^{-8}+\frac14u^8)$
$u = t+\lambda(t^3-t^{-1})+\lambda\lambda(2t^5-t-t^{-3})+\lambda^3(5t^7-4t^3+t^{-1}-2t^{-5})+\lambda^4(14t^9-15t^5+2t+4t^{-3}-5t^{-7})\ldots$
$\log u = \log t+\lambda(t^2-t^{-2})+\lambda\lambda(\frac32t^4-\frac32t^{-4})+\lambda^3(\frac{10}{3}t^6-2t^2+2t^{-2}-\frac{10}{3}t^{-6})+\lambda^4(\frac{35}{4}t^8-8t^4+8t^{-4}-\frac{35}{4}t^{-8})$
Gesetz gefunden 1839 Oct. 9. Siehe S. 222
